inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A battle stage in the land of the Bloodridge, a sun cult of faceless hooded guardians, the same people as their settlement in the camp: low tents of rotted sepia and ash brown rags, tall black stone obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks, ragged banners with a dark red sun disc on poles, bronze braziers, ram skulls and burial bandages hung on poles, temples in the manner of ancient Egypt. Ash brown, sepia and corroded bronze with ember light, in bright clear full colour. Ember light glows only in the cracks of the obelisks and in braziers, never on the ground. Only the few things named for this place stand here, along the far edge; nothing else is built anywhere in the picture. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. No people anywhere, the fighters are added later. This place: the obelisk quarry, where they cut their obelisks, at noon.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a bright readable battle stage in a real lived in place of a sun cult, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale, readable silhouettes, the open ground calm and even so fighters read on it", "lighting": "Hard white noon sun from straight above, short dark shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5a9ad6", "#cfe4f6", "#ffffff", "#2e2a30", "#54484c", "#9a3a2c", "#d6d2cc", "#b4aea8", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no people. The top third is sky and distant land, and the landmarks stand along the far edge of the open ground with their feet on one line a third of the way down. Everything below that line is one wide open flat ground where two armies will fight, calm and empty from the left edge to the right edge, with nothing standing on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 221, 1000], "desc": "a hard bright noon sky, clear pale blue, almost white near the horizon"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [156, 0, 325, 1000], "desc": "tall quarried cliffs of black stone with bands of rust red rock, cut into huge square steps, small rag awnings on the steps far away"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [292, 0, 377, 1000], "desc": "the foot of the quarry face along the far edge, cut blocks of black stone stacked in rows"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [52, 79, 377, 232], "desc": "a tall black obelisk half carved out of the cliff, still joined to the rock at its back, thin glowing ember cracks in it, a scaffold of poles and rag awnings around it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [234, 392, 377, 726], "desc": "a huge finished black obelisk lying on its side on log rollers, bound with thick ropes, ready to be hauled"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [91, 784, 377, 930], "desc": "a tall timber crane with a corroded bronze hook and ropes, a ragged banner with a dark red sun disc at its top"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [373, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "flat pale grey cut stone floor of the quarry, big smooth slabs with faint chisel marks, crisp and clear, calm and even, no dust, no fog and no rubble"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 0, 1000, 123], "desc": "a rough black stone block in the near foreground, in shadow"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 886, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a low pile of cut black stone blocks in the near foreground, in shadow"}]}}
